types.name: ledger.read.v1.AccountGrouping
types.doc: Account grouping metadata (used when group_by = ACCOUNT).

fields.name: account_code
fields.doc: account bucket code

fields.name: name
fields.doc: human-readable name ("funding", "trading")

types.name: ledger.read.v1.AssetBalance
types.doc:
Fixed-size representation for balances (for Protobuf/WS clients).
 Uses common U128 messages for amounts to keep schema tidy and consistent.

fields.name: asset_id
fields.doc:
Public unified asset id. Resolve symbol from SpotConfig; U128 amounts in
 this message always use fixed 18-decimal ledger scale.

fields.name: trading
fields.doc: Trading balance at fixed 18-decimal ledger scale.

fields.name: funding
fields.doc: Funding balance at fixed 18-decimal ledger scale.

fields.name: reserved
fields.doc: Reserved amount in the trading bucket at fixed 18-decimal ledger scale.

fields.name: available
fields.doc:
Available amount in the trading bucket at fixed 18-decimal ledger scale.
 This is computed as max(trading - reserved, 0).

fields.name: trading_updated_at_ns
fields.doc:
Source timestamp for the trading component in Unix nanoseconds. Zero until
 the component has been observed.

fields.name: funding_updated_at_ns
fields.doc:
Source timestamp for the funding component in Unix nanoseconds. Zero until
 the component has been observed.

fields.name: reserved_updated_at_ns
fields.doc:
Source timestamp for the reserved component in Unix nanoseconds. Zero until
 the component has been observed.

types.name: ledger.read.v1.AssetGrouping
types.doc: Asset grouping metadata (used when group_by = ASSET).

fields.name: id
fields.doc: public asset id (0 for "OTHER" bucket)

fields.name: symbol
fields.doc: asset symbol ("BTC", "ETH", "OTHER")

types.name: ledger.read.v1.BalanceRange
types.doc: Supported history windows for balance charts.

types.name: ledger.read.v1.BalanceSeries
types.doc:
Columnar balance series payload (scaled integers).
 REST renders decimal strings from these values.

fields.name: asset_id
fields.doc: public unified asset id

fields.name: account_code
fields.doc: account bucket

fields.name: balance_q
fields.doc:
Chart balance in asset units scaled by 1e7 (7 decimals).
 Values are downscaled from 18-decimal ledger balances for compact charting
 and align 1:1 with implicit timestamps.

types.name: ledger.read.v1.EquityGroupBy
types.doc: How to group equity series data.

types.name: ledger.read.v1.EquitySeries
types.doc:
Columnar equity series payload (scaled integers).
 REST renders decimal strings from these values.

fields.name: account
fields.doc: set when group_by = ACCOUNT

fields.name: asset
fields.doc: set when group_by = ASSET

fields.name: equity_q
fields.doc:
Equity in quote currency (USDT) scaled by 1e4 (4 decimals).
 Values align 1:1 with timestamps.

types.name: ledger.read.v1.ErrorCode
types.doc:
ErrorCode enumerates stable machine-readable error codes for the Ledger Read
 API. These mirror the REST problem+json "code" field for parity between REST
 and ConnectRPC clients.

values.name: ERROR_CODE_MISSING_ACCOUNT_ID
values.doc: Missing or invalid account identifier (legacy; used by older endpoints).

values.name: ERROR_CODE_MISSING_WALLET
values.doc: Wallet-specific errors for balance lookups by wallet.

values.name: ERROR_CODE_UPSTREAM_ERROR
values.doc: Upstream dependency error (e.g., transfers store, wallet resolver).

types.name: ledger.read.v1.ErrorDetail
types.doc:
ErrorDetail is attached to ConnectRPC errors for structured error handling.
 Clients can inspect this to get a stable machine-readable error code.

fields.name: code
fields.doc: Stable error code matching the REST problem+json "code" field.

fields.name: subaccount_id
fields.doc:
Optional sub-account to scope balances to. If omitted, balances are
 returned for the authenticated root account derived from the JWT or API
 key. The logical account id itself is always derived from the caller's JWT
 or API key, not from this payload.

fields.name: range
fields.doc: History window to return. When unset/UNSPECIFIED, defaults to 1D.

fields.name: ledger
fields.doc: Optional public asset filter. When unset/0, returns all assets.

fields.name: account_codes
fields.doc:
Optional subset of account buckets to return. When empty, returns all
 account buckets.

fields.name: subaccount_id
fields.doc:
Optional sub-account to scope balances to. If omitted, balances are
 returned for the authenticated root account derived from the JWT or API
 key. The logical account id itself is always derived from the caller's JWT
 or API key, not from this payload.

types.name: ledger.read.v1.GetEquityHistorySeriesRequest
types.doc:
Equity history in USDT (or BTC via client-side conversion using btc_prices).
 Values are derived from per-asset balances and market prices (close ticks).

fields.name: subaccount_id
fields.doc:
Optional sub-account to scope equity to. If omitted, equity is returned for
 the authenticated root account derived from the JWT or API key.

fields.name: range
fields.doc: History window to return. When unset/UNSPECIFIED, defaults to 1D.

fields.name: account_codes
fields.doc:
Optional subset of account buckets.
 When empty, server returns both funding and trading.
 Only used when group_by = ACCOUNT.

fields.name: group_by
fields.doc: How to group the equity series. Defaults to ACCOUNT if unspecified.

fields.name: quote_asset
fields.doc: Human-readable quote asset symbol (always "USDT").

fields.name: btc_prices_q
fields.doc:
BTC-USDT close price at each timestamp, scaled by 1e6 (same as price_ticks).
 Enables client-side conversion to BTC denomination without refetch.

types.name: ledger.read.v1.HoldRow
types.doc: Hold row with compact integers and client-side resolution.

fields.name: hold_id
fields.doc: pending transfer id (numeric)

fields.name: amount_reserved_e18
fields.doc: Reserved amount at fixed 18-decimal ledger scale.

fields.name: asset_id
fields.doc: Public unified asset id.

fields.name: subaccount_id
fields.doc:
Optional sub-account to scope holds to. If omitted, holds are listed for
 the authenticated root account derived from the JWT or API key.

fields.name: limit
fields.doc:
Maximum number of holds to return. Defaults to 100 when omitted; maximum is
 1000.

fields.name: reversed
fields.doc: true=newest first; false=oldest first.

fields.name: page_token
fields.doc:
Opaque keyset cursor from a previous response. The cursor is exclusive and
 bound to account, sub-account scope, and sort direction.

fields.name: next_page_token
fields.doc: Opaque cursor for the next page. Empty when no more results exist.

cel.message: ts_max_us must be >= ts_min_us when both are set

fields.name: subaccount_id
fields.doc:
Optional sub-account to scope transfers to. If omitted, transfers are
 listed for the authenticated root account derived from the JWT or API key.

fields.name: limit
fields.doc:
Maximum number of transfer rows to return. Defaults to 100 when omitted;
 maximum is 1000.

fields.name: reversed
fields.doc:
Sort direction. When true, rows are returned newest first; when false,
 rows are returned oldest first.

fields.name: ts_min_us
fields.doc:
Optional lower transfer timestamp bound in microseconds since epoch (UTC),
 inclusive.

fields.name: ts_max_us
fields.doc:
Optional upper transfer timestamp bound in microseconds since epoch (UTC),
 inclusive.

fields.name: transfer_code
fields.doc: Optional filter by transfer reason.

fields.name: ledger
fields.doc: Optional filter by asset ledger.

fields.name: page_token
fields.doc:
Opaque keyset cursor from a previous response. The cursor is exclusive and
 bound to the authenticated account, sub-account scope, filters, timestamp
 bounds, and sort direction.

fields.name: transfers
fields.doc: Transfer rows in requested order.

fields.name: next_page_token
fields.doc: Opaque cursor for the next page. Empty when no more results exist.

types.name: ledger.read.v1.TransferRow
types.doc: Transfer row with compact integers and client-side resolution.

fields.name: asset_id
fields.doc:
Public unified asset id. Resolve symbol from SpotConfig; U128 amounts in
 this row always use fixed 18-decimal ledger scale.

fields.name: amount_e18
fields.doc: Transfer amount at fixed 18-decimal ledger scale.

fields.name: transfer_code
fields.doc: product reason for this transfer

fields.name: account_code
fields.doc: account bucket affected by this transfer

fields.name: ts_us
fields.doc: transfer timestamp in microseconds since epoch (UTC)

fields.name: balance_after_e18
fields.doc: Post-transfer balance at fixed 18-decimal ledger scale.

fields.name: is_debit
fields.doc: true for debit legs, false for credit legs

fields.name: link_id
fields.doc: Correlation id derived from ME matchId for grouping related legs (0 when N/A).

fields.name: flow_id
fields.doc: Public lifecycle flow id when this transfer belongs to a chain lifecycle flow.

fields.name: source
fields.doc:
Ledger debit side for From-column display. This is debit-to-credit, not
 row-relative; use is_debit to know whether this row is the debit leg.

fields.name: destination
fields.doc:
Ledger credit side for To-column display. This is debit-to-credit, not
 row-relative; use is_debit to know whether this row is the credit leg.

types.name: ledger.read.v1.TransferSide
types.doc: TransferSide describes one side of a ledger transfer for display.

fields.name: account_id
fields.doc:
Public root or subaccount id when this side is safe to identify. Never
 populated for private counterparties or non-user ledger accounts.

fields.name: address
fields.doc:
Address for this side when known. For EXTERNAL_ADDRESS this is an
 external-chain wallet address from lifecycle correlation; for identifiable
 Polyester user ledger accounts this is a Polyester smart-account address.
 May be empty during the transfer-to-lifecycle consistency window.

types.name: ledger.read.v1.TransferSideKind
types.doc: TransferSideKind identifies the display class for one side of a transfer.

values.name: EXTERNAL_ADDRESS
values.doc:
External wallet or chain address. The address is lifecycle-derived and may
 be empty until ledger-to-lifecycle correlation is projected.

values.name: PRIVATE_COUNTERPARTY
values.doc:
Private off-chain counterparty that must not be identified to the caller.
 account_id and address are intentionally omitted.

values.name: FEE_ACCOUNT
values.doc: Fee ledger side, for example spot or perp trading fees.

values.name: SYSTEM_ACCOUNT
values.doc: System, operator, clearing, or other non-user side.
